# Northmark Chimney
> Chimney cleaning, inspection, repair and maintenance for homeowners in Toronto and the GTA. Phone (416) 505-6228. Every Day 7:00–22:00. The inspection visit is free, at the customer's home, with the exact price given on the spot before any work starts.

## Facts
- Phone: (416) 505-6228
- Email: Northmarkchimney@gmail.com
- Hours: Every Day 7:00–22:00
- Service area: Toronto, York, East York, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Concord, Thornhill, Richmond Hill, Markham
- The inspection visit is free and takes place at the customer's home; camera photos of what is found; the exact price is given on the spot before any work begins; no obligation.
- 3+ years in business. 2,000+ chimneys serviced.
- Every job carries a warranty covering both materials and labour.
- Current offer: standard chimney sweep $200 this winter, free inspection included.
